camel_example: aliyun facebody AddFace --region cn-hangzhou --EntityId U1 --ImageUrl 'https://viapi-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/test/imgsearch/demo/1.png' --DbName default
description_en: Describes the syntax and examples of the AddFace operation for adding face data
description_zh: 本文介绍添加人脸数据AddFace的语法及示例
kebab_example: aliyun facebody add-face --db-name default --image-url https://viapi-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/test/imgsearch/demo/1.png --entity-id U1 --api-version 2019-12-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddFace

parameters.help_en: The database name. The name can contain lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_), and must be 1 to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 数据库名称。支持小写字母、数字、下划线的组合，长度1~64
parameters.name: db_name

parameters.help_en: The URL of the face image. The face must be a frontal, unobstructed face. If the image contains multiple faces, the largest face is added. We recommend that you use an Object Storage Service (OSS) link in the China (Shanghai) region. For local files or OSS links in other regions, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html. The URL cannot exceed 1024 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 人脸图片地址，人脸必须是正面无遮挡人脸（若包含多张人脸则取最大人脸添加）。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。URL长度不超过1024个字符
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en: The entity ID that uniquely identifies a user, such as a user ID or employee ID. Each entity can contain multiple face images. The ID can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_), and must be 1 to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 实体ID，用来标识用户的唯一性，如用户ID、员工ID等。每个实体可包含多张人脸图片。支持大小写字母、数字、下划线的组合，长度为1~64
parameters.name: entity_id

parameters.help_en: The custom information. The value can contain letters, digits, punctuation marks, and Chinese characters. The value cannot exceed 512 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 自定义信息。支持字母、数字、标点符号和汉字。不超过512个字符
parameters.name: extra_data

parameters.help_en: The quality score threshold. The system performs quality analysis on the new face image. If the quality score is less than this threshold, the face image does not meet quality requirements and the addition fails. Valid values: [0.0, 100.0]. A value of 0.0 or empty indicates that quality score evaluation is not performed
parameters.help_zh: 质量分阈值。对新增人脸图片进行质量分析判断，得到的质量分小于该阈值则表示新增人脸图片质量不符合要求，添加失败。取值范围[0.0,100.0]。0.0或空则表示不做质量分判断逻辑
parameters.name: quality_score_threshold

parameters.help_en: The intra-entity similarity threshold. The system compares the new face image with existing faces within the specified EntityId. If the similarity score is less than this threshold, the new face image differs significantly from other face images and the addition fails. If no faces exist within the EntityId, the addition succeeds. Valid values: [0.0, 100.0]. A value of 0.0 or empty indicates that intra-entity similarity evaluation is not performed. For reference values, see the Thresholds field in the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151891.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 类内相似度阈值。将新增人脸图片与EntityId内已有人脸进行相似比对，小于该阈值则表示与其他人脸图片差异较大，添加失败.；若EntityId内没有人脸存在，则添加成功。取值范围[0.0,100.0]。0.0或空则表示不做类内相似度判断逻辑。参考值见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151891.html接口的返回结果字段**Thresholds**
parameters.name: similarity_score_threshold_in_entity

parameters.help_en:
The inter-entity similarity threshold. The system compares the new face image with existing faces in all other EntityId entries. If the similarity score is greater than or equal to this threshold, a similar face exists in another EntityId, indicating a duplicate, and the addition fails. Valid values: [0.0, 100.0]. A value of 0.0 or empty indicates that inter-entity similarity evaluation is not performed. For reference values, see the Thresholds field in the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151891.html operation.

The inter-entity similarity threshold check applies only to the first face image uploaded for each EntityId
parameters.help_zh:
类间相似度阈值。将新增人脸图片与其他所有EntityId内已有人脸进行相似比对，大于等于该阈值则表示其他EntityId内存在相似人脸，出现重复，添加失败。取值范围[0.0,100.0]。0.0或空则表示不做类间相似度判断逻辑。参考值见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151891.html接口的返回结果字段**Thresholds**。

类间相似度阈值检查仅适用于每个EntityId下首次上传的第一张人脸图片
parameters.name: similarity_score_threshold_between_entity

QualitieScore.description_en: The quality score of the face in the input image
QualitieScore.description_zh: 输入图像中的人脸质量分
